canonical_title: Night vision imaging system compatibility of exterior lighting
subject_group: 10.1.5 Aerial refueling sensing, data, visual cues, and lighting systems compatibility

versions.title_at_revision: Night vision imaging system compatibility of exterior lighting
versions.text:
Standard: Exterior lights utilized during AR are NVIS compatible for both visual (naked eye visible light spectrum) and covert (not naked eye visible) modes. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examination of system specifications verifies exterior lighting utilized during AR operations is NVIS compatible. Demonstration.
  (1) Air vehicle ground demonstration verifies exterior lights utilized during AR are NVIS compatible. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (1) Flight test: Flight testing verifies exterior lighting is NVIS compatible. For human operated systems, qualitative crewmember assessments verify NVIS compatibility with visible and covert exterior lights to accomplish all AR tasks within the full range of the system’s mission defined environmental conditions. Test points include receiver join up and echelon, astern, and contact positions.
